larpyourresume

AI-assisted résumé builder that turns existing résumés into tailored applications with LaTeX-quality PDF output.

AI-assisted résumé builder that turns existing résumés into tailored applications with LaTeX-quality PDF output.

Key features include the Sisyphus AI assistant, job-specific tailoring, form and LaTeX editing, customizable layouts, autosave, and PDF export.

Tech stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Gemini, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Stripe, Docker, LuaLaTeX.
